snippet.title: GreeDrill - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
You owe the Company $2,000,000. Pay it back in ore, one quota at a time.

GreeDrill is a push-your-luck mining roguelike in pixel art. Every cell you drill fills your hold and pays more the deeper you go, but brings you closer to the crash. Surface now and the load is yours. Drill one more and it's all at risk.

⛏️ 5 worlds, 5 Guardians, each fight unlike the others
💼 The Bailiff seizes your surplus: outrun the seals
🔧 140 Company licenses to rebuild your drill
🏁 Gold Rush speedrun mode + global leaderboards at launch

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5013610
🎮 Free demo during Steam Next Fest, October 19-26
📅 Release: December 10, 2026

Made by one developer.

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@greedrillgame
Discord: https://discord.gg/5nPfERtadN

#GreeDrill #indiegame #roguelike
